subject.title: MercadoLibre listings sold in Hamelyn remain live and purchasable

question: Should Marketplace maintainers consolidate this older MercadoLibre oversell report into https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/7178, or keep both open while the reconciliation/backfill plan is defined?
rationale: Current dev does not implement the full fix, and the required remediation likely touches many production records/listings, so maintainer intent is needed before consolidation or a backfill path.

options.title: Use the newer issue as canonical
